author: salivan
text:
hiya folks

thanks Omid, if you don't mind this my read on price , i my self always repeat this algorithm in my mind and eyes :

plan the BB plan to grab some more orders from unsuspected traders and
excite BO and also pullback traders as the most poorest traders in the
world , always bear in mind when a supply created before it's good
enough to fake it out above and be the only one with short in true
supply .

assume you have billions of dollar and you want to make LQ , you want to
 be the only sellers in this scale of your chart . you want to make
pools of LQ , when you can not make this then that will be a big loss
for you and you also can not make this LQ just in one bounce in price ,
so that you must play with fear and hope of retailers , then you enter
last pocket of orders and the heaviest sure , so what is going to
happen in this chart ??

create supply , drop price , rally it , let others sell , again drop it
,bcz retailers put orders again there , they think that if price reject
for times in a LVL then that lvl is more stronger and price will reject
again there , so let them think i this way , we need them .again rally
price and make an FO above to true S where we have free OF, then all
fear ,all sellers close their short and make buy , now this is time for
us to jump in and in fact this is where news come in .

ps. in first chart . "transaction"

regards

Salivan

salivan
text:
i my self don't look for S/R and i think the reason is clear, that's
why the (S/R)s always find value when a FL create not with out FL. the
chart is full of S/R but our chart is not covered by a lot of FL.
 and again the reason is clear you can prove it in terms of OF for your
self . when the transaction of orders executed then balance in base of a
 Flag create and this balance still valid till an other imbalance start
and ENG prior balance so that now we need an opposite transaction of OF
to be execute.

if we can understand why do FLs create and what is their obligation in
price structure in terms of OF then i think it's easy to find them in
two confirmation :

1.

An FTR that hold price up or down is FL(BUFL,BEFL)

2.

FL is a kind of FTR that ENGULF an other FL.

hope it helps you

best

Salivan
